result.reason: The operative language fully achieves the fallback but not the preferred position. The added ownership subsection is unrelated and unnecessary to achieve the fallback, so the redline is not minimal. The fallback transfer language also overrides the approval requirement only for the licence, which is consistent with the requested scope, although the references to “section 2(a)” and “section 2.1” are inconsistent with the displayed numbering and reduce drafting quality.
